$comment: Illustrative profile for the restricted variant of a service record: the one a provider gives a customer under a confidentiality agreement. It extends Service Disclosure with two tightenings: coverage of every interface, and the implementing library on every interface without withholding. The public variant may leave internal links out and withhold the library.
title: Service Disclosure, Restricted (Example)

objective.consumer: A customer under a confidentiality agreement with the provider
objective.decision: Whether the provider's internal cryptography is acceptable for the data the customer will place in the service

overrides.note: Tightened: a customer under agreement must be able to match every interface to library advisories.

productRules.description: Service states coverage of all interfaces
productRules.note: The public variant may declare all-external and leave internal links out. The restricted variant may not.

exclusions.reason: The base profile's rules already apply to every interface the restricted variant declares.

changelog.summary: Initial version, built on Keycloak run as a managed service.
